import Mathlib

namespace OAI

 

namespace CycleClique
open scoped SimpleGraph

 

def RamseyProperty (m n N : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ G : SimpleGraph (Fin N),
    SimpleGraph.cycleGraph m ⊑ G ∨ (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) ⊑ Gᶜ

 

noncomputable def cycleCliqueRamsey (m n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  sInf {N : ℕ | RamseyProperty m n N}

 

theorem thm_main :
    (∀ m n : ℤ, n ≤ m → 3 ≤ n → (m, n) ≠ (3, 3) →
      (cycleCliqueRamsey m.toNat n.toNat : ℤ) = (m - 1) * (n - 1) + 1) ∧
    cycleCliqueRamsey 3 3 = 6 := by
  sorry

end CycleClique

end OAI

namespace OAI

namespace CycleClique

/-- The Hamiltonicity specialization for graphs with no independent triple. -/
abbrev CEAlphaTwo := Construction.CEAlphaTwo

/-- Chvátal–Erdős Hamiltonicity at order at least six, with independence at most two. -/
theorem ceAlphaTwo_proved : CEAlphaTwo := Construction.ceAlphaTwo_proved

/-- Exact cycle–clique Ramsey numbers away from the exceptional triangle pair. -/
theorem cycle_clique_main_unconditional {m n : ℕ}
    (hn : 3 ≤ n) (hnm : n ≤ m) (hexcept : (m, n) ≠ (3, 3)) :
    IsRamseyNumber m n ((m - 1) * (n - 1) + 1) :=
  (Construction.isRamseyNumber_iff (by omega)).mp
    (Construction.cycle_clique_main_unconditional hn hnm hexcept)

/-- The exact least forcing order, including the exceptional value six. -/
theorem cycle_clique_ramsey_unconditional {m n : ℕ}
    (hn : 3 ≤ n) (hnm : n ≤ m) :
    IsRamseyNumber m n (if m = 3 ∧ n = 3 then 6 else (m - 1) * (n - 1) + 1) :=
  (Construction.isRamseyNumber_iff (by omega)).mp
    (Construction.cycle_clique_ramsey_unconditional hn hnm)

/-- The labelled construction computes the same Ramsey number as graph containment. -/
theorem cycleCliqueRamsey_unconditional {m n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) (hnm : n ≤ m) :
    cycleCliqueRamsey m n =
      if m = 3 ∧ n = 3 then 6 else (m - 1) * (n - 1) + 1 :=
  cycleCliqueRamsey_eq_of_isRamseyNumber (cycle_clique_ramsey_unconditional hn hnm)

end CycleClique

end OAI
